raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #64436. Gemma4 MoE expert LoRA adapters produced by PEFT use the fused 3D layout, but Gemma4 does not declare `is_3d_moe_weight`, so loading them with the default configuration raises a `ValueError` inside EngineCore and kills the engine. This PR declares `is_3d_moe_weight` on both Gemma4 model classes and fills in the text config `architectures` that the 3D wrapper needs when a nested checkpoint is loaded through `Gemma4ForCausalLM`.

## Claims

- PEFT-format (fused 3D) expert LoRA adapters load on Gemma4 MoE with the default configuration, for `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration`, a standalone `Gemma4ForCausalLM` checkpoint, and a multimodal checkpoint loaded with `hf_overrides={"architectures": ["Gemma4ForCausalLM"]}`.
- Served output with the adapter matches the base model with the LoRA delta merged into the expert weights, and matches a Hugging Face PEFT fp32 reference within bf16 noise.

## Validation

New test `tests/lora/test_gemma4_moe_lora.py` builds a tiny random Gemma4 MoE (2 layers, 8 experts, top-2), writes a fused 3D expert adapter, and compares prompt logprobs of the LoRA request against the base model with the delta merged into the expert weights. It covers the multimodal checkpoint, a standalone text checkpoint, and the multimodal checkpoint loaded through `Gemma4ForCausalLM` via `hf_overrides`. It runs in the existing `LoRA` CI step, which collects all of `tests/lora`.

```bash
pytest -v tests/lora/test_gemma4_moe_lora.py
```

Before (main @ 5d35ce3934):

```text
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[mm] FAILED
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[text] FAILED
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[mm-checkpoint-text-model] FAILED
ValueError: LoRA adapter 1 contains fused 3D MoE weights for 'language_model.model.layers.0.experts', but the model uses a 2D MoE LoRA wrapper. ...
ValueError: LoRA adapter 1 contains fused 3D MoE weights for 'model.layers.0.experts', but the model uses a 2D MoE LoRA wrapper. ...
3 failed
```

With only `is_3d_moe_weight` set, the `mm-checkpoint-text-model` case fails at engine startup, before any adapter is loaded:

```text
ValueError: model_config.architectures must be defined for MoE LoRA.
```

After (rebased on main @ 3966924d56):

```text
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[mm] PASSED
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[text] PASSED
test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged[mm-checkpoint-text-model] PASSED
3 passed
```

In the test, the mean absolute logprob difference between base and merged is 0.24–0.26; between the LoRA request and merged it is ~0.005 (the assertion threshold is 10% of the base/merged difference).

Independent check against Hugging Face PEFT 0.21.2 (`target_parameters=["experts.gate_up_proj", "experts.down_proj"]`, r=8, alpha=16) on a tiny random 4-layer Gemma4 MoE, comparing vLLM bf16 prompt logprobs with the PEFT fp32 reference:

| Configuration | LoRA vs PEFT reference | LoRA vs base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| main, `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration`, default | `ValueError`, EngineCore dies | – |
| main, `--enable-mixed-moe-lora-format` + `is_3d_lora_weight=True` | 0.0185 | 0.252 |
| this PR, `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration`, default | 0.0184 | 0.252 |
| this PR, `Gemma4ForCausalLM`, default | 0.0192 | 0.255 |

Mean absolute difference per prompt position. The PEFT reference difference between adapter and base is 0.251; vLLM bf16 base vs the fp32 reference is 0.025.

`pytest tests/lora/test_lora_manager.py`: 40 passed. Changed-file pre-commit (including mypy) passed.

All runs used a single Intel Arc Pro B70 (XPU), TP=1, eager mode.

## Details

Root cause: Gemma4 keeps all experts in fused 3D tensors, so PEFT expert adapters store one flat `lora_A`/`lora_B` pair per projection. `LoRAModelManager` chooses `FusedMoE3DWithLoRA` only when the model sets `is_3d_moe_weight`; Gemma4 did not, so it used the 2D `FusedMoEWithLoRA`, and `_validate_moe_lora_format` rejects fused 3D weights for 2D wrappers unless mixed format is enabled. The fix follows the other fused 3D MoE models (Qwen3.5 MoE, Qwen3-VL-MoE, gpt-oss). No checkpoint name mapping is needed: on current main the experts are registered as `layers.N.experts`, which already matches the PEFT names.

`FusedMoE3DWithLoRA` reads `architectures` from the model config. Released Gemma4 checkpoints declare it only at the top level, so `Gemma4ForCausalLM` (which keeps the nested `text_config`) sets `architectures` when it is missing, as PaliGemma and LLaVA do for their text configs. The multimodal class already passes `architectures=["Gemma4ForCausalLM"]` when building its language model.

Tradeoff: Gemma4 now defaults to the 3D wrapper, so a 2D (per-expert, megatron-style) Gemma4 adapter needs `--enable-mixed-moe-lora-format` with `is_3d_lora_weight=false`, as documented in `docs/features/lora.md`. The Hugging Face Gemma4 model has no per-expert submodules, so PEFT produces only the fused 3D layout.

Not duplicating existing work: #43254 adds `is_3d_moe_weight` and `get_expert_mapping` to `Gemma4ForCausalLM` only (the multimodal class used to serve the released checkpoints is unchanged, and `get_expert_mapping` is already provided by the MoE layer on main); it has had no updates since 2026-10-13. #50252 changes `_GEMMA4_EXPERT_PARENT_MAPPER`, which no longer exists on main. Unsloth exports Gemma4 MoE expert adapters in the same fused 3D layout (see the MoE comment in #41754).

Limitations: validated on Intel XPU only, TP=1, with tiny random models; no CUDA run and no full-size checkpoint with a trained adapter. EP and fully sharded LoRA use the existing `FusedMoE3DWithLoRA` paths and were not exercised here.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Gemma4 MoE expert LoRA in the fused 3D PEFT layout.
+
+PEFT `target_parameters` adapters store one flat tensor pair per projection:
+`experts.base_layer.lora_{A,B}` for `gate_up_proj` and `experts.lora_{A,B}` for
+`down_proj`. Serving such an adapter must match serving the base model with the
+LoRA delta merged into the expert weights.
+"""
+
+import json
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from safetensors.torch import load_file, save_file
+from transformers import Gemma4Config
+from transformers.models.gemma4.modeling_gemma4 import (
+    Gemma4ForCausalLM,
+    Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration,
+)
+
+import vllm
+from vllm.distributed import cleanup_dist_env_and_memory
+from vllm.lora.request import LoRARequest
+from vllm.transformers_utils.repo_utils import hf_api
+
+NUM_EXPERTS = 8
+HIDDEN = 256
+MOE_INTERMEDIATE = 128
+NUM_LAYERS = 2
+RANK = 8
+ALPHA = 16
+VOCAB = 262144
+TOKENIZER_FILES = [
+    "tokenizer.json",
+    "tokenizer_config.json",
+    "processor_config.json",
+    "chat_template.jinja",
+]
+
+
+def _config() -> Gemma4Config:
+    return Gemma4Config(
+        text_config=dict(
+            vocab_size=VOCAB,
+            vocab_size_per_layer_input=VOCAB,
+            hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+            hidden_size_per_layer_input=0,
+            intermediate_size=512,
+            moe_intermediate_size=MOE_INTERMEDIATE,
+            num_hidden_layers=NUM_LAYERS,
+            layer_types=["sliding_attention", "full_attention"],
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_key_value_heads=2,
+            num_global_key_value_heads=1,
+            head_dim=64,
+            global_head_dim=128,
+            num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+            top_k_experts=2,
+            enable_moe_block=True,
+            sliding_window=64,
+            max_position_embeddings=1024,
+            num_kv_shared_layers=0,
+        ),
+        vision_config=dict(num_hidden_layers=1, default_output_length=280),
+    )
+
+
+def _merge(weight: torch.Tensor, lora_a: torch.Tensor, lora_b: torch.Tensor):
+    """Add the per-expert delta of a fused 3D LoRA pair to a 3D expert weight.
+
+    lora_a is (num_experts * rank, in), expert-major; lora_b is
+    (out, rank * num_experts), expert-minor.
+    """
+    a = lora_a.view(NUM_EXPERTS, RANK, -1)
+    b = lora_b.view(lora_b.shape[0], RANK, NUM_EXPERTS).permute(2, 0, 1)
+    return weight + (ALPHA / RANK) * torch.bmm(b, a)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def gemma4_tokenizer_dir() -> Path:
+    return Path(
+        hf_api().snapshot_download(
+            repo_id="google/gemma-4-E2B-it", allow_patterns=TOKENIZER_FILES
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _build(root: Path, tokenizer_dir: Path, multimodal: bool) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    config = _config()
+    if multimodal:
+        model = Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration(config)
+        ckpt_prefix = "model.language_model.layers"
+    else:
+        model = Gemma4ForCausalLM(config.text_config)
+        ckpt_prefix = "model.layers"
+    base_dir, merged_dir, lora_dir = (root / n for n in ("base", "merged", "lora"))
+    for model_dir in (base_dir, merged_dir):
+        model.save_pretrained(model_dir)
+        for name in TOKENIZER_FILES:
+            shutil.copy(tokenizer_dir / name, model_dir / name)
+
+    weights = load_file(merged_dir / "model.safetensors")
+    adapter = {}
+    for layer in range(NUM_LAYERS):
+        experts = f"{ckpt_prefix}.{layer}.experts"
+        peft = f"base_model.model.{experts}"
+        for proj, module, in_dim, out_dim in (
+            ("gate_up_proj", "base_layer.", HIDDEN, 2 * MOE_INTERMEDIATE),
+            ("down_proj", "", MOE_INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN),
+        ):
+            lora_a = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS * RANK, in_dim) * 0.1
+            lora_b = torch.randn(out_dim, RANK * NUM_EXPERTS) * 0.1
+            adapter[f"{peft}.{module}lora_A.weight"] = lora_a
+            adapter[f"{peft}.{module}lora_B.weight"] = lora_b
+            name = f"{experts}.{proj}"
+            weights[name] = _merge(weights[name].float(), lora_a, lora_b).to(
+                weights[name].dtype
+            )
+    save_file(weights, merged_dir / "model.safetensors", metadata={"format": "pt"})
+
+    lora_dir.mkdir()
+    save_file(adapter, lora_dir / "adapter_model.safetensors")
+    (lora_dir / "adapter_config.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "peft_type": "LORA",
+                "r": RANK,
+                "lora_alpha": ALPHA,
+                "target_modules": [],
+                "target_parameters": ["experts.gate_up_proj", "experts.down_proj"],
+                "bias": "none",
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    return str(base_dir), str(merged_dir), str(lora_dir)
+
+
+def _prompt_logprobs(
+    model: str, lora_path: str | None = None, hf_overrides: dict | None = None
+) -> list[list[list[float]]]:
+    """Prompt logprobs without LoRA, then with `lora_path` if given."""
+    llm = vllm.LLM(
+        model,
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        max_model_len=256,
+        max_num_seqs=4,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.3,
+        enable_lora=True,
+        max_lora_rank=RANK,
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 0},
+        hf_overrides=hf_overrides,
+    )
+    try:
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
+        prompts = [
+            torch.randint(1000, 10000, (32,), generator=generator).tolist()
+            for _ in range(3)
+        ]
+        params = vllm.SamplingParams(max_tokens=1, prompt_logprobs=0, detokenize=False)
+        loras = [None]
+        if lora_path is not None:
+            loras.append(LoRARequest("expert-3d", 1, lora_path))
+        results = []
+        for lora in loras:
+            outputs = llm.generate(
+                [{"prompt_token_ids": p} for p in prompts], params, lora_request=lora
+            )
+            results.append(
+                [_token_logprobs(out, p) for out, p in zip(outputs, prompts)]
+            )
+        return results
+    finally:
+        del llm
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+def _token_logprobs(output: vllm.RequestOutput, prompt: list[int]) -> list[float]:
+    assert output.prompt_logprobs is not None
+    logprobs = []
+    for token, position in zip(prompt[1:], output.prompt_logprobs[1:]):
+        assert position is not None
+        logprobs.append(position[token].logprob)
+    return logprobs
+
+
+def _mean_abs_diff(x: list[list[float]], y: list[list[float]]) -> float:
+    diffs = [abs(a - b) for xs, ys in zip(x, y) for a, b in zip(xs, ys)]
+    return sum(diffs) / len(diffs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("multimodal", "hf_overrides"),
+    [
+        (True, None),
+        (False, None),
+        (True, {"architectures": ["Gemma4ForCausalLM"]}),
+    ],
+    ids=["mm", "text", "mm-checkpoint-text-model"],
+)
+def test_gemma4_moe_3d_expert_lora_matches_merged(
+    tmp_path, gemma4_tokenizer_dir, multimodal, hf_overrides
+):
+    base, merged, lora = _build(tmp_path, gemma4_tokenizer_dir, multimodal)
+
+    base_lp, lora_lp = _prompt_logprobs(base, lora, hf_overrides)
+    (merged_lp,) = _prompt_logprobs(merged, hf_overrides=hf_overrides)
+
+    signal = _mean_abs_diff(merged_lp, base_lp)
+    assert signal > 0.1
+    assert _mean_abs_diff(lora_lp, merged_lp) < 0.1 * signal
